payload.title: No UI path creates a day plan: the empty meal board has no action and 'Regenerate' acts on today's plan, not on the card's date, and reports GENERATED with a null plan id when it did nothing
payload.rule_violated: An operator can recover from a missing plan in the UI, and an operation that did nothing says so
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: With the cron down (FARM-CRITICAL-479) the 'Assignments without a plan today' strip lists the units but offers no button. On a COMPLETED plan the existing-plan filter misses it, persistDayPlan is ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and the mutation answers outcome GENERATED with dayPlanId null. Fix: a per-unit 'Generate today's plan' action; take (unitId, planDate) and return an explicit NOOP outcome.
